statement: When a registered matter of a stock company changes, the change must be registered at the seat of the principal office within two weeks (Commercial Act Article 183, applied to stock-company registrations by Article 317(4)).
caveat: Article 183 was wholly amended on September 20, 2024, removing the former branch-office registration duplication; specific corporate events (new share issues, mergers, dissolution) carry their own registration articles whose clocks run from their own effective dates. Late registration is subject to administrative fines.
